responsibility: Performs method candidate search for a receiver type by enumerating autoderef steps, collecting inherent, trait, object, and where-clause candidates, filtering them by name, mode, visibility, and applicability, and selecting the best match or structured failure. It owns the intermediate probe state used both for actual resolution and for diagnostics such as ambiguity, unsatisfied bounds, private matches, and similar-name suggestions. It also handles method lookup performed for diagnostics and suggestions; when suggestion probing encounters autoderef ambiguity or an unresolved receiver type, this file decides whether to stop probing instead of continuing with an invalid candidate state.
